name: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
benefit:
- Under this scheme, players aged 8 to 14 years are selected every year on the basis of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT). 
  - From each district, 150 boys and 150 girls are selected (25 boys and 25 girls from each age group: 8–9 years, 9–10 years, 10–11 years, 11–12 years, 12–13 years, and 13–14 years). 
  - Each selected player is awarded a scholarship of ₹1,500/- per month for one
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 8 and 14 years of age. 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competition, conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strength, flexibility, endurance, speed, and coordination, will be eligible for the sports scholarship.
